$comment: Section 20 (Roads & Auto-Naming) of docs/METROPOLIS-MASTER-v2.1.md, transcribed into a structured place-name-corpus + class-appropriate-suffix schema for deterministic seed+id road naming. FEAT-047 / data.modes-naming, ASM-223. The 8 place names §20 cites by example (Cheriton, Seabrook, Pent, Risborough, Sandgate, Downs, Alkham, Saltwood) are present verbatim; the remaining entries are real Kent/Romney Marsh/Folkestone-Hythe-area toponyms (matching the game's Folkestone start tile per CLAUDE.md) added to satisfy §20's own 'reads like a place, not a spreadsheet' standard, which an 8-name corpus visibly fails at city scale. Coverage floor of 40 entries is a BA judgment call logged as ASM-392 (a 5x multiplier on the 8 spec-cited examples) -- see docs/planning/acceptance/data.modes-naming.md AC-9. See docs/design/modes-naming-external-schema.md for the full field reference.
numberedSchemeNote: Urban expressway and motorway classes (the two highest rungs of engine.roads' 11-rung class ladder, engine.roads.md AC-3) are explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for this file's place-name+suffix pairing -- §20 states they use the M-/A- numbering scheme instead ('motorways numbered M-, A-'). This is a deliberate, documented omission (engine.roads.md AC-9's own numbering-scheme carve-out), not a gap: only the 9 non-numbered classes below have suffix entries.

categories.roadSuffixesNote: Suffix lists are class-appropriate, not one universal list copy-pasted across all 9 classes (data.modes-naming.md AC-10's named lazy-implementation failure mode): 'Close' and 'Lane' (lower-tier, quieter) appear only on alley/gravel/residential_street; 'Avenue' (higher-tier, grander) appears only on avenue_2_plus_2; 'Way'/'Drive' cluster on the higher-capacity classes (avenue_2_plus_2, bus_lane_variant, tram_track_variant, dual_carriageway). Base suffix set per §20: Lane/Road/Street/Avenue/Way/Drive/Close. 'Mews' and 'Track' are documented class-appropriate extensions beyond §20's literal seven-word list -- 'Mews' for the alley/mews-scale lowest rung, 'Track' for unsurfaced gravel roads (matching data/buildings.json's 'gravel_road'/'dirt_track' catalogue entries' own descriptive convention).
